result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a vertical alignment defect: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is shifted down relative to its neighbours, so images, time badges and titles don't line up across the row. A couple of smaller inconsistencies were also found in card styling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is offset roughly 25px lower than the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' cards. Its image top edge, the '20–30 min' badge and the restaurant name/delivery-fee lines all sit below the same elements on the neighbouring cards, giving the row a staggered, broken appearance.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items the same fixed height and align them to the top (e.g. align-items: flex-start / stretch) so images, badges and text baselines line up consistently.

issues.description: Time-badge placement differs between cards in the same carousel: on the first card the '15–25 min' pill sits near the bottom-left of the image, while on the other cards it is positioned lower/overlapping differently, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the duration badge to a consistent offset (e.g. bottom-left with fixed padding) inside every card image.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) buttons in the 'Popular right now' list are styled inconsistently — the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white outline heart, while the card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use a single favourite-button component with identical background, size and icon styling across all cards.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail uses a light grey background while all other food thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, making the first card look like a placeholder or failed image load.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent imagery treatment (or a matching placeholder style) so all cards read as the same content type.
